features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.desc: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Cha modifier + Warlock level.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.desc: You add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw (after the roll). A number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.desc: After a rest, you choose a damage type (other than Force); you gain Resistance to it.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.desc: When you hit with an attack, you send the target (not a boss) to the Lower Planes for 1 turn, dealing Psychic damage when it returns.
